label: Town of Sutton
header:
# Town of Sutton municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 23; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Sutton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Marlin 'Chip' Devenger called the meeting to order and was re-elected Moderator
Town of Sutton official website, government page: names Tim Simpson (term to 2027), Denis Royer II (to 2028), and Jeffrey 'Joe' Solinsky (to 2029)
Town of Sutton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Jeffrey 'Joe' Solinsky was re-elected March 3, 2026
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Patricia McClure as Sutton's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Patricia McClure as Sutton's Town Clerk
Town of Sutton, Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): attested by Patricia J. McClure as 'Town Clerk & Treasurer'
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Patricia McClure as Sutton's Town Treasurer
Town of Sutton, Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): attested by Patricia J. McClure as 'Town Clerk & Treasurer'
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms
Town of Sutton official website, government page: names Paul Lane (term to 2027), Mary Gray (to 2028), and Candace Heath (to 2029)
Town of Sutton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Candace Heath won the 2026 lister seat
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated

Town of Sutton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Elaine Bandy was elected to the 2026 three-year auditor seat; the holders of the other two seats are published in no official source in hand
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect constables
Town of Sutton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Kurt Nygren was elected First Constable
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect constables); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Sutton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): the minutes record 'No nominations' for Second Constable, so no membership is created
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a grand juror
Town of Sutton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Kathy Keizer was elected Grand Juror
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town agent
Town of Sutton, Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): the warning elects an 'Agent to Convey Real Estate,' the town agent's real-estate function
Town of Sutton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): John Sylvester was elected to the office
Town of Sutton, Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): the warning elects a Water Commissioner from the floor -- a general-franchise town office
Town of Sutton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Scott Spencer was elected Water Commissioner
Town of Sutton, Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): the warning elects a Cemetery Sexton
Town of Sutton official website, government page: names Patricia Jackson, Cemetery Sexton, term to 2027
